It is evident that we have very similar points of view in this regard.

For me, Dash must be decentralized and independent of the system if the user so desires.

Another thing is that the user, for whatever reason, wants their Dash to be visible and associated with their personal or company taxation.

To think that the volume of decentralized exchanges grows every day, and Dash focuses on stupid things again and again, instead of being what "Decentralized Digital Money" promises.

We always look askance at Monero, it is inevitable, especially knowing that one day we were 5x over them, and with much more popularity, however, we, unlike Monero, wanted to cover everything, without specifying anything.

I have always bought Dash on exchanges without KYC, and if for some reason in the future I had to use KYC to buy, sell or hold Dash, rest assured that this will not be my currency, nor that of thousands of potential users.

Remember that they wanted to destroy all privacy currencies, and there they continue to increase in capitalization and volume (XMR, Zcash...)

If we believe that Dash is digital cash, it would be very interesting to see what the partner says, and add Dash to that decentralized wallet with all its feartures.

When Dash was included in Maya, it was advertised on Reddit, on Discord, everywhere... but since then, it seems like we've been focusing on interesting, but not so necessary, things.

Greetings and health.
